errors.text_span: 该图表显示了 11 个切片，每个切片代表一种不同的动词域。
errors.evidence: The figure contains two separate pie charts, not one chart with 11 slices.

errors.text_span: “生活工作”切片呈浅蓝色，占大约 23.3%；“物质事态”切片呈深蓝色，占 23.4%；“生活动”切片呈橙色，占 16.91%；“社会”切片呈粉色，占 6.6%；“身体动作”切片呈黄色，占 9.9%；“功能活动”切片呈绿色，占 10.64%；“时尚”切片呈棕色，占 8.51%；“交通”切片呈蓝色，占 5.32%；“交易”切片呈紫色，占18.09%；“事件”切片呈灰色，占 9.57%；“其他”切片呈红色，占 5.57% 和 9.48%。
errors.evidence: The machine description assigns many incorrect category names and color mappings. For example, the left chart has '生产' 16.91% (green), not '生活动'; the right chart has '物态事态' 23.4%, not '物质事态'; and '其他' appears only once in the left chart at 19.38%, not as red 5.57% and 9.48%.

errors.text_span: “生活工作”切片呈浅蓝色，占大约 23.3%；“物质事态”切片呈深蓝色，占 23.4%；“生活动”切片呈橙色，占 16.91%；“社会”切片呈粉色，占 6.6%；“身体动作”切片呈黄色，占 9.9%；“功能活动”切片呈绿色，占 10.64%；“时尚”切片呈棕色，占 8.51%；“交通”切片呈蓝色，占 5.32%；“交易”切片呈紫色，占18.09%；“事件”切片呈灰色，占 9.57%；“其他”切片呈红色，占 5.57% 和 9.48%。
errors.evidence: Several percentages are attached to the wrong categories. For instance, 18.09% belongs to '方位改变', 10.64% belongs to '心理活动' and '司法', 9.57% belongs to '争斗', 8.51% belongs to '判断', 5.32% belongs to '表情' and '际遇', 4.26% belongs to '帮助' and '交通', and 19.38% belongs to '其他'.
The description does not clearly state that the figure shows the distribution of male verb semantic domains, as indicated by the caption and the figure.
The description does not mention the legend that maps colors to categories or that percentages are shown on the slices, both of which are important visible features.
The figure consists of two separate pie charts with a legend and percentage labels; the description incorrectly says there are no legend or percentage labels and omits the two-chart structure.

errors.text_span: 切片按照从左到右的顺序排列，也没有称为图例或百分比标签。有些切片，例如“交易”和“其他”切片，视觉上略微突出，提高了这些切片的可见度。
errors.evidence: The figure does not arrange slices left-to-right; pie slices are circular sectors, not ordered linearly. It also clearly includes a legend and percentage labels, and no slice is specially highlighted or exploded.
